# Compatibility matrix

Every recipe, run on every engine by `cook generate`. `✓` the shared query passes, `✓*` a dialect-specific variant passes, `–` the engine can't do it (the page says why), `·` not run on this machine.

CI runs this on PostgreSQL 16, 17 and 18, MySQL 8.0, 8.4 and 9, and the SQLite and DuckDB builds that ship with Python. The website shows the exact versions of the run that built it.
